craft_claim: Consolation literature models care-in-suffering as presence-with-reframing: the consoler stays with the grief before offering a larger frame, so a reframe that can be moved before the disclosure of pain is unearned consolation.

supporting_evidence.note: Boethius's Philosophy first diagnoses the prisoner's sickness and sits with him before applying argument; the return to reason is graduated and follows acknowledgment of grief.
The work is the tradition's most-cited template for care expressed inside another's/one's suffering, showing that reframing is offered last, not first.

counterevidence.note: Modern reception contests whether the Boethian frame silences legitimate complaint (consolation shading into theodicy), so the tradition is a model and a warning.

scope: Consoling prose, essays, endings, and any passage that reframes another's loss.
exceptions: Deliberately unsentimental or absurdist writing that refuses consolation as a form; failing to console is not the same as failing at this tone.
